title: Quality Casebook — Keeping a Resumed Payment Arrangement on Its Schedule
content:
A resumed plan under Payment Arrangements keeps to its own schedule where its record allows: the restart alignment places the earliest restart day on the plan's schedule according to the plan's frequency and record.

## Governing rule

The kept installment payments are the installment payments received under the plan less those returned.

- A monthly plan with at least 3 kept installment payments keeps its due day of the month, taken from the schedule anchor date, and restarts on the first such day on or after the earliest restart day.
- A weekly or biweekly plan with at least 3 kept installment payments keeps its cycle and restarts on the first date on or after the earliest restart day that lies a whole number of periods (7 days weekly, 14 days biweekly) from the schedule anchor date.
- A plan with fewer than 3 kept installment payments restarts on the earliest restart day itself.

The aligned date is expressed as calendar days from the handling date. A date that falls exactly on the earliest restart day counts as "on or after" it.

## Casebook entries (hypothetical plans; handling date 3 August, earliest restart day 17 August)

**Entry 1 — monthly, 5 kept payments, schedule anchor date 5 March.** Due day of the month: the 5th. The first 5th on or after 17 August is 5 September: 33 calendar days from 3 August.

**Entry 2 — monthly, 4 kept payments, schedule anchor date 20 May.** The first 20th on or after 17 August is 20 August: 17 calendar days.

**Entry 3 — biweekly, 6 kept payments, schedule anchor date 1 July.** Cycle dates: 1 July, 15 July, 29 July, 12 August, 26 August. The first on or after 17 August is 26 August: 23 calendar days.

**Entry 4 — monthly, 2 kept payments.** Fewer than 3: the plan restarts on 17 August itself, 14 calendar days.

**Entry 5 — weekly, 3 kept payments, schedule anchor date 10 August.** Cycle dates: 10 August, 17 August. 17 August lies on the cycle and is on or after the earliest restart day: 14 calendar days.

## Table

| Frequency | Kept installment payments | Restarts on |
|---|---|---|
| Monthly | 3 or more | First day on or after the earliest restart day carrying the plan's due day of the month |
| Weekly or biweekly | 3 or more | First cycle date on or after the earliest restart day |
| Any | 2 or fewer | The earliest restart day itself |
